# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

import json
import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse as sp
from scipy.optimize import minimize, NonlinearConstraint, Bounds

def solve_opf():
    # 1. Load Data
    print("Loading network.json...")
    with open('network.json', 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']
    bus_data = np.array(data['bus'])
    gen_data = np.array(data['gen'])
    branch_data = np.array(data['branch'])
    gencost_data = np.array(data['gencost'])

    # Constants and Mappings
    nb = bus_data.shape[0]
    ng = gen_data.shape[0]
    nl = branch_data.shape[0]

    # Map bus ID to index
    bus_id_map = {int(id): i for i, id in enumerate(bus_data[:, 0])}
    
    # Indices
    BUS_I, BUS_TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN = range(13)
    GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, GEN_STATUS, PMAX, PMIN = range(10)
    F_BUS, T_BUS, BR_R, BR_X, BR_B, RATE_A, RATE_B, RATE_C, TAP, SHIFT, BR_STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX = range(13)
    
    # Adjust 0-based indexing for calculations
    f = np.array([bus_id_map[int(id)] for id in branch_data[:, F_BUS]])
    t = np.array([bus_id_map[int(id)] for id in branch_data[:, T_BUS]])

    # 2. Build Ybus
    print("Building Ybus...")
    # Resistance and Reactance
    r = branch_data[:, BR_R]
    x = branch_data[:, BR_X]
    z = r + 1j * x
    y = 1 / z
    b_ch = branch_data[:, BR_B] # Total line charging suspectance

    # Tap ratios and phase shifters
    tap = branch_data[:, TAP]
    tap[tap == 0] = 1.0 # Replace 0 with 1
    shift = branch_data[:, SHIFT] * np.pi / 180.0
    tap_cmplx = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)

    # Branch Admittances
    Y_tt = y + 1j * b_ch / 2
    Y_ff = Y_tt / (np.abs(tap_cmplx) ** 2)
    Y_ft = -y / np.conj(tap_cmplx)
    Y_tf = -y / tap_cmplx

    # Shunt Admittances
    Y_sh = (bus_data[:, GS] + 1j * bus_data[:, BS]) / baseMVA # Assuming GS/BS are in MW/MVAr at 1.0 p.u. voltage? 
    # Usually in MATPOWER GS/BS are in MW/MVAr demanded at V=1.0. So admittance is (Gs+jBs)/baseMVA if Gs/Bs are in MW.
    # Let's verify standard: "GS, shunt conductance (MW demanded at V = 1.0 p.u.)". Yes.
    
    # Build Sparse Matrix
    rows = np.concatenate([f, f, t, t])
    cols = np.concatenate([f, t, f, t])
    data_y = np.concatenate([Y_ff, Y_ft, Y_tf, Y_tt])
    
    Ybus = sp.coo_matrix((data_y, (rows, cols)), shape=(nb, nb)).tocsr()
    Ybus = Ybus + sp.diags(Y_sh)
    
    G = Ybus.real
    B = Ybus.imag

    # 3. Optimization Problem Setup
    
    # Variables: [Va (nb), Vm (nb), Pg (ng), Qg (ng)]
    # Initial Guess
    Va0 = np.radians(bus_data[:, VA])
    Vm0 = bus_data[:, VM]
    Pg0 = gen_data[:, PG] / baseMVA
    Qg0 = gen_data[:, QG] / baseMVA
    
    x0 = np.concatenate([Va0, Vm0, Pg0, Qg0])
    
    n_va = nb
    n_vm = nb
    n_pg = ng
    n_qg = ng
    
    idx_va = slice(0, nb)
    idx_vm = slice(nb, 2*nb)
    idx_pg = slice(2*nb, 2*nb+ng)
    idx_qg = slice(2*nb+ng, 2*nb+2*ng)

    # Bounds
    # Va: -pi to pi (except ref bus)
    va_min = np.full(nb, -np.pi)
    va_max = np.full(nb, np.pi)
    
    # Ref bus angle fixed to 0
    ref_buses = np.where(bus_data[:, BUS_TYPE] == 3)[0]
    va_min[ref_buses] = 0.0
    va_max[ref_buses] = 0.0
    
    # Vm: Vmin to Vmax
    vm_min = bus_data[:, VMIN]
    vm_max = bus_data[:, VMAX]
    
    # Gen Limits
    pg_min = gen_data[:, PMIN] / baseMVA
    pg_max = gen_data[:, PMAX] / baseMVA
    qg_min = gen_data[:, QMIN] / baseMVA
    qg_max = gen_data[:, QMAX] / baseMVA
    
    # Active Generators Only?
    # Usually we optimize dispatchable generators. If status=0, force output to 0.
    off_gens = gen_data[:, GEN_STATUS] <= 0
    pg_min[off_gens] = 0
    pg_max[off_gens] = 0
    qg_min[off_gens] = 0
    qg_max[off_gens] = 0
    
    bounds = Bounds(
        np.concatenate([va_min, vm_min, pg_min, qg_min]),
        np.concatenate([va_max, vm_max, pg_max, qg_max])
    )

    # Generators Mapping to Buses
    gen_bus_idx = np.array([bus_id_map[int(bid)] for bid in gen_data[:, GEN_BUS]])
    Cg = sp.coo_matrix((np.ones(ng), (gen_bus_idx, np.arange(ng))), shape=(nb, ng)).tocsr()
    
    Pd = bus_data[:, PD] / baseMVA
    Qd = bus_data[:, QD] / baseMVA

    # Objective Function
    # Cost = sum(c2*P^2 + c1*P + c0)
    # Note: P in gencost is usually in MW. My variable Pg is in p.u.
    # Cost function expects MW.
    
    def objective(x):
        Pg_pu = x[idx_pg]
        Pg_mw = Pg_pu * baseMVA
        cost = 0
        for i in range(ng):
            # c2, c1, c0 are at indices 4, 5, 6
            c2 = gencost_data[i, 4]
            c1 = gencost_data[i, 5]
            c0 = gencost_data[i, 6]
            cost += c2 * Pg_mw[i]**2 + c1 * Pg_mw[i] + c0
        return cost

    def objective_grad(x):
        Pg_pu = x[idx_pg]
        Pg_mw = Pg_pu * baseMVA
        grad = np.zeros_like(x)
        
        dCost_dPg_mw = 2 * gencost_data[:, 4] * Pg_mw + gencost_data[:, 5]
        dCost_dPg_pu = dCost_dPg_mw * baseMVA
        
        grad[idx_pg] = dCost_dPg_pu
        return grad

    # Constraints
    # P_mismatch = Cg*Pg - Pd - P_inj(Va, Vm) = 0
    # Q_mismatch = Cg*Qg - Qd - Q_inj(Va, Vm) = 0
    
    def get_power_injection(Va, Vm):
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        # S = V * conj(I) = V * conj(Ybus * V)
        I = Ybus.dot(V)
        S = V * np.conj(I)
        return S.real, S.imag
    
    def power_balance(x):
        Va = x[idx_va]
        Vm = x[idx_vm]
        Pg = x[idx_pg]
        Qg = x[idx_qg]
        
        P_inj, Q_inj = get_power_injection(Va, Vm)
        
        # Generation injection at buses
        P_gen_bus = Cg.dot(Pg)
        Q_gen_bus = Cg.dot(Qg)
        
        P_mis = P_gen_bus - Pd - P_inj
        Q_mis = Q_gen_bus - Qd - Q_inj
        
        return np.concatenate([P_mis, Q_mis])

    # Jacobian of Power Balance
    # We need dMis/dX.
    # dP_mis/dPg = Cg
    # dP_mis/dQg = 0
    # dP_mis/dVa = -dP_inj/dVa
    # dP_mis/dVm = -dP_inj/dVm
    
    def power_balance_jac(x):
        Va = x[idx_va]
        Vm = x[idx_vm]
        
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        I = Ybus.dot(V)
        diagV = sp.diags(V)
        diagI = sp.diags(I)
        diagVm = sp.diags(Vm)
        
        # dS/dVa = j * diag(V) * conj(diag(I) - Ybus * diag(V)) 
        # Actually standard formulas:
        # dS = diag(V) * conj(dI) + diag(conj(I)) * dV
        # dI = Ybus * dV
        # dV/dVa = j * V
        # dV/dVm = V / Vm
        
        dS_dV = sp.diags(V).dot(Ybus.conj()) + sp.diags(np.conj(I))
        # Wait, d(V * conj(Y*V)) ...
        
        # Let's use standard sparse matrix operations for Jacobian
        # dS_dVa = j * V .* conj(I) - V .* conj(Ybus * (j * V))
        #        = j * V .* conj(I) + V .* conj(Ybus) * conj(-j * V)
        #        = j * V .* conj(I) - j * V .* (Ybus.conj() * V.conj())
        
        # Better formulation:
        # dS_dVa = j * diag(V) * (conj(diag(I)) - Ybus.conj() * diag(V).conj())
        #        = j * diag(V) * (conj(diag(I)) - Ybus.conj() * diag(V.conj()))
        
        # dS_dVm = diag(V) * (conj(diag(I)) * diag(1/Vm) + Ybus.conj() * diag(V.conj() * 1/Vm))
        #        = diag(V/Vm) * conj(diag(I)) + diag(V) * Ybus.conj() * diag(V.conj()/Vm)
        
        # This is getting complicated to implement with sparse matrices purely from scratch without errors.
        # But for 300 buses, dense matrices are acceptable! 300x300 = 90k floats.
        # Let's use dense arithmetic for the Jacobian construction to be safe and simple.
        
        V_dense = V
        I_dense = I
        Y_dense = Ybus.toarray()
        
        # Diagonal matrices
        D_V = np.diag(V_dense)
        D_I_conj = np.diag(np.conj(I_dense))
        D_V_conj = np.diag(np.conj(V_dense))
        D_Vm_inv = np.diag(1.0 / Vm)
        
        # dS / dVa = j * V * conj(I) - V * conj(Y * j * V) -> incorrect
        
        # Analytic derivatives of S = V .* conj(Y * V) w.r.t V
        # dS = diag(V) * conj(Y * dV) + diag(conj(Y * V)) * dV
        # dS = diag(V) * conj(Y) * conj(dV) + diag(conj(I)) * dV
        
        # dV / dVa = j * diag(V)
        # dV / dVm = diag(V / Vm)
        
        # dS / dVa = diag(V) * conj(Y) * conj(j * diag(V)) + diag(conj(I)) * j * diag(V)
        #          = diag(V) * conj(Y) * (-j * diag(conj(V))) + j * diag(conj(I) * V)
        #          = -j * diag(V) * conj(Y) * diag(conj(V)) + j * diag(S.conj())
        
        # dS / dVm = diag(V) * conj(Y) * conj(diag(V/Vm)) + diag(conj(I)) * diag(V/Vm)
        #          = diag(V) * conj(Y) * diag(conj(V)/Vm) + diag(S.conj()/Vm)
        
        term1 = -1j * D_V @ Y_dense.conj() @ D_V_conj
        term2 = 1j * np.diag(V_dense * np.conj(I_dense))
        dS_dVa = term1 + term2
        
        term3 = D_V @ Y_dense.conj() @ (D_V_conj @ D_Vm_inv)
        term4 = np.diag(V_dense * np.conj(I_dense) / Vm)
        dS_dVm = term3 + term4
        
        # Jacobian blocks
        J11 = dS_dVa.real # dP/dVa
        J12 = dS_dVm.real # dP/dVm
        J21 = dS_dVa.imag # dQ/dVa
        J22 = dS_dVm.imag # dQ/dVm
        
        # Full Jacobian: [dP/dVa dP/dVm dP/dPg dP/dQg; dQ/dVa dQ/dVm dQ/dQg dQ/dQg]
        # P_mis = Cg*Pg - Pd - P_inj
        # dP_mis/dVa = -J11
        # dP_mis/dVm = -J12
        # dP_mis/dPg = Cg
        # dP_mis/dQg = 0
        
        # Q_mis = Cg*Qg - Qd - Q_inj
        # dQ_mis/dVa = -J21
        # dQ_mis/dVm = -J22
        # dQ_mis/dPg = 0
        # dQ_mis/dQg = Cg
        
        Cg_dense = Cg.toarray()
        Zeros = np.zeros((nb, ng))
        
        top = np.hstack([-J11, -J12, Cg_dense, Zeros])
        bot = np.hstack([-J21, -J22, Zeros, Cg_dense])
        
        return np.vstack([top, bot])

    # Define NonlinearConstraint
    # Equality constraints (lb=ub=0)
    con_eq = NonlinearConstraint(power_balance, 0, 0, jac=power_balance_jac)
    
    # Solve
    print("Solving OPF...")
    res = minimize(
        objective, 
        x0, 
        method='SLSQP', 
        jac=objective_grad,
        bounds=bounds,
        constraints=[con_eq],
        options={'maxiter': 500, 'ftol': 1e-4, 'disp': True}
    )
    
    print(f"Solver Status: {res.message}")
    print(f"Success: {res.success}")
    
    # 4. Process Results
    x_opt = res.x
    Va_opt = x_opt[idx_va]
    Vm_opt = x_opt[idx_vm]
    Pg_opt = x_opt[idx_pg]
    Qg_opt = x_opt[idx_qg]
    
    V_opt = Vm_opt * np.exp(1j * Va_opt)
    
    # Calculate Flows
    # I_ij = (V_i - V_j) * Y_ij ... need to be careful with line model
    # I_from = Y_ff * V_from + Y_ft * V_to
    # I_to = Y_tf * V_from + Y_tt * V_to
    
    V_from = V_opt[f]
    V_to = V_opt[t]
    
    I_from = Y_ff * V_from + Y_ft * V_to
    I_to = Y_tf * V_from + Y_tt * V_to
    
    S_from = V_from * np.conj(I_from) * baseMVA
    S_to = V_to * np.conj(I_to) * baseMVA
    
    # Branch Limits (MVA)
    rateA = branch_data[:, RATE_A]
    loading = np.maximum(np.abs(S_from), np.abs(S_to))
    limit_mask = rateA > 0
    pct_loading = np.zeros_like(loading)
    pct_loading[limit_mask] = loading[limit_mask] / rateA[limit_mask] * 100
    
    # Summary
    cost_total = objective(x_opt)
    load_total_MW = np.sum(Pd) * baseMVA
    load_total_MVAr = np.sum(Qd) * baseMVA
    gen_total_MW = np.sum(Pg_opt) * baseMVA
    gen_total_MVAr = np.sum(Qg_opt) * baseMVA
    losses_MW = gen_total_MW - load_total_MW
    
    # Generators Output
    gens_out = []
    for i in range(ng):
        gens_out.append({
            "id": int(i + 1),
            "bus": int(gen_data[i, GEN_BUS]),
            "pg_MW": round(Pg_opt[i] * baseMVA, 2),
            "qg_MVAr": round(Qg_opt[i] * baseMVA, 2),
            "pmin_MW": gen_data[i, PMIN],
            "pmax_MW": gen_data[i, PMAX],
            "qmin_MVAr": gen_data[i, QMIN],
            "qmax_MVAr": gen_data[i, QMAX]
        })
        
    # Buses Output
    buses_out = []
    for i in range(nb):
        buses_out.append({
            "id": int(bus_data[i, BUS_I]),
            "vm_pu": round(Vm_opt[i], 3),
            "va_deg": round(np.degrees(Va_opt[i]), 2),
            "vmin_pu": bus_data[i, VMIN],
            "vmax_pu": bus_data[i, VMAX]
        })
        
    # Most Loaded Branches (Top 10)
    most_loaded_idx = np.argsort(pct_loading)[::-1][:10]
    branches_out = []
    for i in most_loaded_idx:
        branches_out.append({
            "from_bus": int(bus_data[f[i], BUS_I]),
            "to_bus": int(bus_data[t[i], BUS_I]),
            "loading_pct": round(pct_loading[i], 1),
            "flow_from_MVA": round(np.abs(S_from[i]), 1),
            "flow_to_MVA": round(np.abs(S_to[i]), 1),
            "limit_MVA": float(rateA[i]) if rateA[i] > 0 else None
        })
        
    # Feasibility Check
    eq_violations = np.abs(power_balance(x_opt))
    max_p_mis = np.max(eq_violations[:nb]) * baseMVA
    max_q_mis = np.max(eq_violations[nb:]) * baseMVA
    
    # Voltage violations
    v_viol = np.maximum(0, vm_min - Vm_opt) + np.maximum(0, Vm_opt - vm_max)
    max_v_viol = np.max(v_viol)
    
    # Branch violations
    br_viol = np.maximum(0, loading - rateA)
    br_viol[~limit_mask] = 0
    max_br_viol = np.max(br_viol)

    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": round(cost_total, 2),
            "total_load_MW": round(load_total_MW, 2),
            "total_load_MVAr": round(load_total_MVAr, 2),
            "total_generation_MW": round(gen_total_MW, 2),
            "total_generation_MVAr": round(gen_total_MVAr, 2),
            "total_losses_MW": round(losses_MW, 2),
            "solver_status": "optimal" if res.success else res.message
        },
        "generators": gens_out,
        "buses": buses_out,
        "most_loaded_branches": branches_out,
        "feasibility_check": {
            "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_p_mis, 4),
            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_q_mis, 4),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_viol, 4),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_br_viol, 4)
        }
    }
    
    print("Writing report.json...")
    with open('report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
    print("Done.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve_opf()

import json
import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse as sp
from scipy.optimize import minimize, NonlinearConstraint, Bounds

def solve_opf():
    # 1. Load Data
    print("Loading network.json...")
    with open('network.json', 'r') as f:
        data = json.load(f)

    baseMVA = data['baseMVA']
    bus_data = np.array(data['bus'])
    gen_data = np.array(data['gen'])
    branch_data = np.array(data['branch'])
    gencost_data = np.array(data['gencost'])

    # Constants and Mappings
    nb = bus_data.shape[0]
    ng = gen_data.shape[0]
    nl = branch_data.shape[0]

    bus_id_map = {int(id): i for i, id in enumerate(bus_data[:, 0])}
    
    BUS_I, BUS_TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN = range(13)
    GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, GEN_STATUS, PMAX, PMIN = range(10)
    F_BUS, T_BUS, BR_R, BR_X, BR_B, RATE_A, RATE_B, RATE_C, TAP, SHIFT, BR_STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX = range(13)
    
    f = np.array([bus_id_map[int(id)] for id in branch_data[:, F_BUS]])
    t = np.array([bus_id_map[int(id)] for id in branch_data[:, T_BUS]])

    # 2. Build Ybus
    print("Building Ybus...")
    r = branch_data[:, BR_R]
    x = branch_data[:, BR_X]
    z = r + 1j * x
    y = 1 / z
    b_ch = branch_data[:, BR_B]

    tap = branch_data[:, TAP]
    tap[tap == 0] = 1.0
    shift = branch_data[:, SHIFT] * np.pi / 180.0
    tap_cmplx = tap * np.exp(1j * shift)

    Y_tt = y + 1j * b_ch / 2
    Y_ff = Y_tt / (np.abs(tap_cmplx) ** 2)
    Y_ft = -y / np.conj(tap_cmplx)
    Y_tf = -y / tap_cmplx

    Y_sh = (bus_data[:, GS] + 1j * bus_data[:, BS]) / baseMVA
    
    rows = np.concatenate([f, f, t, t])
    cols = np.concatenate([f, t, f, t])
    data_y = np.concatenate([Y_ff, Y_ft, Y_tf, Y_tt])
    
    Ybus = sp.coo_matrix((data_y, (rows, cols)), shape=(nb, nb)).tocsr()
    Ybus = Ybus + sp.diags(Y_sh)
    Ybus_conj = Ybus.conj()

    # 3. Optimization Problem Setup
    Va0 = np.radians(bus_data[:, VA])
    Vm0 = bus_data[:, VM]
    Pg0 = gen_data[:, PG] / baseMVA
    Qg0 = gen_data[:, QG] / baseMVA
    
    x0 = np.concatenate([Va0, Vm0, Pg0, Qg0])
    
    idx_va = slice(0, nb)
    idx_vm = slice(nb, 2*nb)
    idx_pg = slice(2*nb, 2*nb+ng)
    idx_qg = slice(2*nb+ng, 2*nb+2*ng)

    # Bounds
    va_min = np.full(nb, -np.pi)
    va_max = np.full(nb, np.pi)
    ref_buses = np.where(bus_data[:, BUS_TYPE] == 3)[0]
    va_min[ref_buses] = 0.0
    va_max[ref_buses] = 0.0
    
    vm_min = bus_data[:, VMIN]
    vm_max = bus_data[:, VMAX]
    
    pg_min = gen_data[:, PMIN] / baseMVA
    pg_max = gen_data[:, PMAX] / baseMVA
    qg_min = gen_data[:, QMIN] / baseMVA
    qg_max = gen_data[:, QMAX] / baseMVA
    
    off_gens = gen_data[:, GEN_STATUS] <= 0
    pg_min[off_gens] = 0
    pg_max[off_gens] = 0
    qg_min[off_gens] = 0
    qg_max[off_gens] = 0
    
    bounds = Bounds(
        np.concatenate([va_min, vm_min, pg_min, qg_min]),
        np.concatenate([va_max, vm_max, pg_max, qg_max])
    )

    gen_bus_idx = np.array([bus_id_map[int(bid)] for bid in gen_data[:, GEN_BUS]])
    Cg = sp.coo_matrix((np.ones(ng), (gen_bus_idx, np.arange(ng))), shape=(nb, ng)).tocsr()
    
    Pd = bus_data[:, PD] / baseMVA
    Qd = bus_data[:, QD] / baseMVA

    def objective(x):
        Pg_pu = x[idx_pg]
        Pg_mw = Pg_pu * baseMVA
        cost = 0
        # Vectorized cost calculation
        c2 = gencost_data[:, 4]
        c1 = gencost_data[:, 5]
        c0 = gencost_data[:, 6]
        cost = np.sum(c2 * Pg_mw**2 + c1 * Pg_mw + c0)
        return cost

    def objective_grad(x):
        Pg_pu = x[idx_pg]
        Pg_mw = Pg_pu * baseMVA
        grad = np.zeros_like(x)
        dCost_dPg_mw = 2 * gencost_data[:, 4] * Pg_mw + gencost_data[:, 5]
        dCost_dPg_pu = dCost_dPg_mw * baseMVA
        grad[idx_pg] = dCost_dPg_pu
        return grad

    def power_balance(x):
        Va = x[idx_va]
        Vm = x[idx_vm]
        Pg = x[idx_pg]
        Qg = x[idx_qg]
        
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        I = Ybus.dot(V)
        S_inj = V * np.conj(I)
        
        P_gen_bus = Cg.dot(Pg)
        Q_gen_bus = Cg.dot(Qg)
        
        P_mis = P_gen_bus - Pd - S_inj.real
        Q_mis = Q_gen_bus - Qd - S_inj.imag
        
        return np.concatenate([P_mis, Q_mis])

    def power_balance_jac(x):
        Va = x[idx_va]
        Vm = x[idx_vm]
        
        V = Vm * np.exp(1j * Va)
        I = Ybus.dot(V)
        
        # Diagonal matrices (sparse)
        D_V = sp.diags(V)
        D_V_conj = sp.diags(np.conj(V))
        D_I_conj = sp.diags(np.conj(I))
        D_Vm_inv = sp.diags(1.0 / Vm)
        
        # dS/dVa
        # Term 1: -1j * D_V * Ybus.conj() * D_V_conj
        t1 = -1j * D_V.dot(Ybus_conj).dot(D_V_conj)
        # Term 2: 1j * diag(V * conj(I))
        t2 = 1j * sp.diags(V * np.conj(I))
        dS_dVa = t1 + t2
        
        # dS/dVm
        # Term 3: D_V * Ybus.conj() * D_V_conj * D_Vm_inv
        t3 = D_V.dot(Ybus_conj).dot(D_V_conj).dot(D_Vm_inv)
        # Term 4: diag(V * conj(I) / Vm)
        t4 = sp.diags(V * np.conj(I) / Vm)
        dS_dVm = t3 + t4
        
        # Extract Real and Imag parts
        # Note: sp.real() / sp.imag() might not be available for all sparse formats in older scipy?
        # Converting to CSR helps.
        dS_dVa = dS_dVa.tocsr()
        dS_dVm = dS_dVm.tocsr()
        
        J11 = dS_dVa.real # dP/dVa
        J12 = dS_dVm.real # dP/dVm
        J21 = dS_dVa.imag # dQ/dVa
        J22 = dS_dVm.imag # dQ/dVm
        
        # P_mis = Cg*Pg - Pd - P_inj
        # dP_mis/dVa = -J11
        # dP_mis/dVm = -J12
        # dP_mis/dPg = Cg
        
        # Q_mis = Cg*Qg - Qd - Q_inj
        # dQ_mis/dVa = -J21
        # dQ_mis/dVm = -J22
        # dQ_mis/dQg = Cg
        
        # Construct large sparse matrix
        # Columns: Va, Vm, Pg, Qg
        # Rows: P_mis, Q_mis
        
        # We need to construct the blocks.
        # Top Left: [-J11, -J12]
        # Bottom Left: [-J21, -J22]
        
        Zeros_gen = sp.csr_matrix((nb, ng))
        
        # Top row blocks
        Top = sp.hstack([-J11, -J12, Cg, Zeros_gen])
        # Bottom row blocks
        Bot = sp.hstack([-J21, -J22, Zeros_gen, Cg])
        
        Jac = sp.vstack([Top, Bot])
        return Jac

    con_eq = NonlinearConstraint(power_balance, 0, 0, jac=power_balance_jac)
    
    print("Solving OPF with trust-constr...")
    res = minimize(
        objective, 
        x0, 
        method='trust-constr', 
        jac=objective_grad,
        bounds=bounds,
        constraints=[con_eq],
        options={'maxiter': 1000, 'verbose': 2, 'xtol': 1e-4, 'gtol': 1e-4}
    )
    
    print(f"Solver Status: {res.message}")
    print(f"Success: {res.success}")
    
    # 4. Process Results
    x_opt = res.x
    Va_opt = x_opt[idx_va]
    Vm_opt = x_opt[idx_vm]
    Pg_opt = x_opt[idx_pg]
    Qg_opt = x_opt[idx_qg]
    
    V_opt = Vm_opt * np.exp(1j * Va_opt)
    
    V_from = V_opt[f]
    V_to = V_opt[t]
    
    I_from = Y_ff * V_from + Y_ft * V_to
    I_to = Y_tf * V_from + Y_tt * V_to
    
    S_from = V_from * np.conj(I_from) * baseMVA
    S_to = V_to * np.conj(I_to) * baseMVA
    
    rateA = branch_data[:, RATE_A]
    loading = np.maximum(np.abs(S_from), np.abs(S_to))
    limit_mask = rateA > 0
    pct_loading = np.zeros_like(loading)
    pct_loading[limit_mask] = loading[limit_mask] / rateA[limit_mask] * 100
    
    cost_total = objective(x_opt)
    load_total_MW = np.sum(Pd) * baseMVA
    load_total_MVAr = np.sum(Qd) * baseMVA
    gen_total_MW = np.sum(Pg_opt) * baseMVA
    gen_total_MVAr = np.sum(Qg_opt) * baseMVA
    losses_MW = gen_total_MW - load_total_MW
    
    gens_out = []
    for i in range(ng):
        gens_out.append({
            "id": int(i + 1),
            "bus": int(gen_data[i, GEN_BUS]),
            "pg_MW": round(Pg_opt[i] * baseMVA, 2),
            "qg_MVAr": round(Qg_opt[i] * baseMVA, 2),
            "pmin_MW": gen_data[i, PMIN],
            "pmax_MW": gen_data[i, PMAX],
            "qmin_MVAr": gen_data[i, QMIN],
            "qmax_MVAr": gen_data[i, QMAX]
        })
        
    buses_out = []
    for i in range(nb):
        buses_out.append({
            "id": int(bus_data[i, BUS_I]),
            "vm_pu": round(Vm_opt[i], 3),
            "va_deg": round(np.degrees(Va_opt[i]), 2),
            "vmin_pu": bus_data[i, VMIN],
            "vmax_pu": bus_data[i, VMAX]
        })
        
    most_loaded_idx = np.argsort(pct_loading)[::-1][:10]
    branches_out = []
    for i in most_loaded_idx:
        branches_out.append({
            "from_bus": int(bus_data[f[i], BUS_I]),
            "to_bus": int(bus_data[t[i], BUS_I]),
            "loading_pct": round(pct_loading[i], 1),
            "flow_from_MVA": round(np.abs(S_from[i]), 1),
            "flow_to_MVA": round(np.abs(S_to[i]), 1),
            "limit_MVA": float(rateA[i]) if rateA[i] > 0 else None
        })
        
    eq_violations = np.abs(power_balance(x_opt))
    max_p_mis = np.max(eq_violations[:nb]) * baseMVA
    max_q_mis = np.max(eq_violations[nb:]) * baseMVA
    
    v_viol = np.maximum(0, vm_min - Vm_opt) + np.maximum(0, Vm_opt - vm_max)
    max_v_viol = np.max(v_viol)
    
    br_viol = np.maximum(0, loading - rateA)
    br_viol[~limit_mask] = 0
    max_br_viol = np.max(br_viol)

    report = {
        "summary": {
            "total_cost_per_hour": round(cost_total, 2),
            "total_load_MW": round(load_total_MW, 2),
            "total_load_MVAr": round(load_total_MVAr, 2),
            "total_generation_MW": round(gen_total_MW, 2),
            "total_generation_MVAr": round(gen_total_MVAr, 2),
            "total_losses_MW": round(losses_MW, 2),
            "solver_status": "optimal" if res.success else res.message
        },
        "generators": gens_out,
        "buses": buses_out,
        "most_loaded_branches": branches_out,
        "feasibility_check": {
            "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_p_mis, 4),
            "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_q_mis, 4),
            "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_viol, 4),
            "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_br_viol, 4)
        }
    }
    
    print("Writing report.json...")
    with open('report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)
    print("Done.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve_opf()
